source_audit.worker_semantics: 32 workers parallelized independent episodes; each method episode and CARE certificate ran in one worker process
source_audit.common_packet_loss_contract: same derived link seed; the transport hashes link seed and stable packet link_key so common packets have identical loss draws
source_audit.query_cap_scope: CARE, Path Top-K and Single-Cell use the additional 8-cell/64-byte algorithmic cap; CARE-Lite uses the codec maximum under the common 512-byte control cap and is not a query-cap-matched comparator

metric_semantics.episode_cpu_ms: per-episode process CPU measured by time.process_time; not wall clock
metric_semantics.planning_cpu_ms: instrumentation-specific planning block; includes the full CARE and Single-Cell selector, only the pessimistic plan for CARE-Lite, and excludes Path Top-K selection; not a cross-method primary runtime
metric_semantics.certificate_cpu_ms: subset of planning CPU spent inside exact CARE certificate construction
metric_semantics.method_extra_planning_calls: plans beyond shared optimistic replans: Single-Cell blocked, CARE-Lite pessimistic, or CARE scenario calls
metric_semantics.certificate_scenario_planning_calls: exact sparse-scenario replans; zero outside CARE
metric_semantics.candidate_cells: episode-total task-aware proposal cells for Path/Single or capped scenario candidates for CARE; not separately recorded for One-shot/CARE-Lite
metric_semantics.query_cells: episode-total cells submitted to the common query-patch codec
metric_semantics.care_minus_method_episode_cpu_ms: paired map-level CARE minus method process CPU
metric_semantics.care_to_method_episode_cpu_ratio: ratio of paired-map episode CPU sums; not mean of per-map ratios

confidence_interval.index_matrix: shared deterministic matrix from scripts/bootstrap_ci.py for map_count=100
confidence_interval.difference: paired percentile interval for CARE-minus-method mean
confidence_interval.ratio: paired percentile interval for ratio of sums

timing_limit: 32 workers parallelized independent single-process episodes; CIs measure between-map variation within that frozen run, not repeated-machine timing uncertainty or online wall latency
comparison_limit: CARE-Lite shares the codec and 512-byte control channel but not the additional 8-cell/64-byte algorithmic cap used by CARE, Path Top-K and Single-Cell
provenance_limit: the frozen run summary did not record generation git SHA, CPU model, frequency controls, CPU pinning, or isolated wall-clock timing
